title: TNF, CD4 help, and iatrogenic TB
dek: TNF holds granulomas together; CD4 T cells run the IFN-γ franchise. Anti-TNF and HIV are the two common ways adults recreate childhood dissemination.
story: TNF (mostly macrophage- and T-cell-derived) maintains granuloma integrity and macrophage activation. Neutralising it — infliximab more than etanercept in the classic hierarchy — collapses containment. Incident TB on anti-TNF is often disseminated or extrapulmonary, and it can appear within months of the first infusion.

CD4 T cells are the antigen-specific IFN-γ (and IL-2/TNF) source that IGRAs try to measure. As CD4 counts fall, both control and the assay fail. That is why advanced HIV is miliary, lymphatic, and smear-negative-with-high-burden at once.

Screening for TB infection before anti-TNF (and other biologics: anti-IL-6, JAK inhibitors, anti-IL-17 with a weaker signal) plus TPT when indicated is host-directed prevention. It is the same axis as MSMD, acquired.
deepTitle: Risk that is not a CFU
deep: Infliximab (monoclonal, membrane TNF, complement) > adalimumab > etanercept (soluble-receptor decoy) in TB risk in observational series. Rank is not a licence to skip screening on etanercept.
Steroids, dialysis, transplantation, and silicosis are parallel iatrogenic/occupational holes. The common language is failed granuloma maintenance.
IRIS after ART or after stopping anti-TNF is the reconstitution mirror: lesions inflame as TNF/CD4 return.
Do not use IGRA conversion to diagnose anti-TNF-associated TB disease. Image, NAAT, culture.

visual.caption: Containment depends on CD4-derived IFN-γ and TNF on the granuloma. HIV and anti-TNF are two cuts on that loop; dissemination is the downstream state.

example.title: Infliximab start with untreated IGRA+
example.setup: Rheumatoid arthritis, IGRA+, normal CXR, no TPT, infliximab infusion planned next week.

steps.title: This is a TPT indication
steps.body: WHO/CDC: treat infection before (or at most with) TNF blockade after ruling out disease.

steps.title: Pick a short rifamycin regimen if drug interactions allow
steps.body: 3HP or 4R are shorter than 6H. Check CYP induction against the rheumatology list.

steps.title: Do not wait for symptomatic TB
steps.body: Anti-TNF TB can be extra-pulmonary and late-presenting. Prevention is the point.

example.takeaway: TNF blockade without TPT is a planned granuloma insult.

check.prompt: TNF’s most TB-relevant host role is:
choices: Maintaining granuloma structure and macrophage activation
Serving as the Xpert Ultra target
check.answer: Maintaining granuloma structure and macrophage activation
check.why: That is why anti-TNF produces reactivation/dissemination.

check.prompt: Observational TB risk on biologics is generally highest with infliximab among the classical agents. A patient starting etanercept still needs:
choices: No screening, because etanercept risk is exactly zero
Disease screen ± IGRA/TST and TPT if indicated — rank is not a skip
Stopping all methotrexate forever as TB therapy
check.answer: Disease screen ± IGRA/TST and TPT if indicated — rank is not a skip

check.prompt: On the flow map, anti-TNF has an arrow into the granuloma node labelled “cuts TNF.” What is the intended downstream state if that cut wins?
check.why: Both HIV and anti-TNF feed the dissemination end node.
check.figureHint: Right-side end nodes: containment vs dissemination.
